title: Better Silk Touch
description: Expands the pool of blocks that Silk Touch works on!
body:
# Better Silk Touch
Made by [**8bitdino**](https://www.youtube.com/@8bitdino) with **100% human** trial & error :3
## Description
This datapack expands the list of blocks that will drop themselves when mined with a Silk Touch tool!
## Affected Blocks
- Budding Amethyst
- Chorus Plant
- Dirt Path
- Farmland
- Frogspawn
- Infested Blocks
- Reinforced Deepslate
- Spawner
- Suspicious Gravel
- Suspicious Sand
- Trial Spawner
- Vault
## Recipes Added
All recipes added are ways to change Infested Blocks into each other, paralleling their non-infested counterparts. (ex. smelting Infested Cobblestone into Infested Stone)
## IMPORTANT
> **Spawners** and **Trial Spawners** will not work once re-placed, unless you have access to Spawn Eggs.

> **Ominous Vaults** will become regular Vaults once re-placed. This is because their ominous property is a block state and not a separate block that can be collected :( Vaults will still work as intended once re-placed.

> **Suspicious Sand and Gravel** will not generate items when brushing after they have been placed. Only naturally generated Suspicious Sand and Gravel will drop items when brushed.
## More
I haven't figured out a good way to make modular datapacks, so don't be afraid to go into the file and delete any .json files in the [loot_table] or [recipe] folders you don't want!

Please let me know if any bugs/issues arise by submitting a report through the dedicated [Google Form](https://forms.gle/UnCkA96xm5q3CV6a8)!
## Credits
Made by **8bitdino**
> Revisions and loot table fix by my friend **MottledPizza** :)

> Recipe advancements made using [Misode's Advancement Generator](https://misode.github.io/advancement/)
